title: Aromatic Canadian Cheese Gratin
description: A buttery, fluffy, indulgent Canadian dish with a hint of heat from chilli powder, finished under a broiler for a golden crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and set the broiler to high.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a medium skillet over medium heat until foamy.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic, 1 tsp hot chilli powder, and smoked paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 1 cup heavy cream, bring to a gentle simmer, and let reduce slightly for 4 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in 1.5 cups grated cheddar, 0.5 cup parmesan, 0.5 tsp salt, and 0.25 tsp pepper until melted.
Transfer mixture to a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish; top with remaining cheese if desired.
Broil for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and bubbling, then remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes before serving.
